title: AR42005: Real Estate Valuation
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

The valuer-his functions and responsibilities; The principle factors affecting
the supply and demand for land and building; Principle types of landed
property; the interest therein and the outgoings thereon. Principles governing
the rates of interest for different types of property; Calculation of rental
values-net income-virtual rent; Valuation for sale and purchase of freehold
